verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents case management with case stages and assignees: cases can be filtered by stage and assignee, reviewed, and closed with decisions. Its agentic workflows also automatically escalate high-risk cases for human review. However, assignment and routing are only implied by filter fields, and there is no documented workflow for assigning cases or setting up analyst-to-escalation stages. Missing for 10: explicit docs on assigning or reassigning cases, configurable multi-stage review/escalation routing, any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a operations-lead, I can assign cases and route them through analyst review and escalation stages

citations.quote: Filter cases by customer risk, case stage, who the case is assigned to, or when it was created.
